decisions.statement: The parts of the HUD the heads-up add-on hides are read from `temper-hud-components`.
The parts the player has shown and hidden are kept across the whole account.
An add-on adding a field to the bar states the order that field sits at.
Nothing here knows the meaning of any other add-on's field.
